baseVariables.name: base-primary-color
baseVariables.usage: Selected nodes, context menu accents, scroll highlight, empty zone

baseVariables.name: base-shadow-color
baseVariables.usage: Shadow colour for the tooltip and touch-drag ghost (one tone with pure-admin)

baseVariables.name: base-outline-width
baseVariables.usage: Shared item-ring thickness; drives --wtv-focused-outline-offset (inset) and the fallback ring width

baseVariables.name: base-highlighted-outline
baseVariables.usage: Shared highlighted-item ring, outline shorthand drawn inset (drives --wtv-highlighted-ring)

baseVariables.name: base-focused-outline
baseVariables.usage: Shared focused (cursor) item ring, outline shorthand drawn inset (drives --wtv-focused-ring)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-1
baseVariables.usage: Primary text (node labels, context menu items)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-3
baseVariables.usage: Secondary text (node paths, toggle icons, divider labels)

baseVariables.name: base-hover-bg
baseVariables.usage: Node hover background, context menu item hover

baseVariables.name: base-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Context menu border, dividers, debug info border, spinner track

baseVariables.name: base-danger-color
baseVariables.usage: Invalid drop indicator, context menu danger items

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-xs
baseVariables.usage: Toggle icons, node paths, debug info (multiplier)

baseVariables.name: base-font-weight-semibold
baseVariables.usage: Debug info headers, drop zone labels

baseVariables.name: base-icon-check
baseVariables.usage: Checkbox checkmark glyph; chained by --wtv-icon-check — mask-image

baseVariables.name: base-icon-indeterminate
baseVariables.usage: Tri-state (partial) checkbox dash glyph; chained by --wtv-icon-indeterminate — mask-image

baseVariables.name: base-icon-check-size
baseVariables.usage: mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the checkbox box; chained by --wtv-icon-check-size (default 68%)

baseVariables.name: base-checkbox-scale
baseVariables.usage: Shared checkbox scale knob; chained by --wtv-checkbox-scale (box/border/radius × this via calc, no transform)

baseVariables.name: base-checkbox-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Dedicated checkbox border color (stronger than --base-border-color); chained by --wtv-checkbox-border-color

componentVariables.name: wtv-rem
componentVariables.usage: Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default: 10px)

componentVariables.name: wtv-highlighted-bg
componentVariables.usage: Selection-highlight background tint (multi-select set); reads --base-highlighted-bg (fallback accent 10%)

componentVariables.name: wtv-highlighted-text
componentVariables.usage: Text color of a highlighted (multi-selected) row; reads --base-highlighted-text-color (fallback currentColor)

componentVariables.name: wtv-highlighted-ring
componentVariables.usage: Outline shorthand for a highlighted row, drawn as an inset outline; reads --base-highlighted-outline (fallback none)

componentVariables.name: wtv-focused-bg
componentVariables.usage: Background of the focused (cursor) row when not highlighted; reads --base-focused-bg (fallback transparent)

componentVariables.name: wtv-focused-text
componentVariables.usage: Text color of the focused (cursor) row; reads --base-focused-text-color (fallback currentColor)

componentVariables.name: wtv-focused-ring
componentVariables.usage: Outline shorthand for the default focus ring, drawn as an inset outline; reads --base-focused-outline (fallback 1px solid accent). Set none to suppress the ring while keeping the --focused hook

componentVariables.name: wtv-focused-outline-offset
componentVariables.usage: Outline offset for the focus ring / highlighted border (default calc(-1 * var(--base-outline-width, 1px)) = inset)

componentVariables.name: wtv-highlight-bg
componentVariables.usage: Background for the opt-in .wtv__node-content--highlight-fill flavor (Explorer-style strong fill); unused by the default highlight state

componentVariables.name: wtv-highlight-color
componentVariables.usage: Text color for the opt-in .wtv__node-content--highlight-fill flavor (default inherit)

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-transition
componentVariables.usage: Node content (row) transition. Default none = instant hover; set e.g. 'background var(--wtv-transition-speed), box-shadow var(--wtv-transition-speed) ease' to animate

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-icon-color
componentVariables.usage: Per-node icon color (default currentColor; overridden by a per-node iconColor / iconColorMember)

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-icon-margin-right
componentVariables.usage: Gap between the per-node icon and the label

componentVariables.name: wtv-node-icon-width
componentVariables.usage: Reserved icon-column width when shouldAlignNodeIcons is on

componentVariables.name: wtv-column-width
componentVariables.usage: Unified column width for toggle, icon, and indent step (24px)

componentVariables.name: wtv-indent-size
componentVariables.usage: Tree node indent per level (= tv-column-width)

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-expand
componentVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph mask (collapsed / the only glyph in rotate mode); chained to --base-icon-chevron. Re-pointed per icon-set.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-collapse
componentVariables.usage: Disclosure glyph mask shown when expanded (swap mode only); chained to --base-icon-collapse for the plus-minus set.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-leaf
componentVariables.usage: Optional leaf marker glyph mask (opt-in via leafIconClass=wtv__toggle-icon--leaf).

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-rotate-collapsed
componentVariables.usage: Collapsed-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (0deg for a right-pointing chevron, -90deg for a down-caret).

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-rotate-expanded
componentVariables.usage: Expanded-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (90deg for chevron).

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-check
componentVariables.usage: Checkmark glyph (mask) for a checked checkbox; chains to --base-icon-check.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-indeterminate
componentVariables.usage: Dash glyph (mask) for a tri-state/partial checkbox; chains to --base-icon-indeterminate.

componentVariables.name: wtv-icon-check-size
componentVariables.usage: mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the box; chains to --base-icon-check-size (default 68%).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-scale
componentVariables.usage: Box/border/radius scale via calc (shared --base-checkbox-scale contract, no transform).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-border-width
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox box border thickness (hairline; multiplied by --wtv-checkbox-scale).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-border-color
componentVariables.usage: Unchecked checkbox box border color; chains to --base-checkbox-border-color.

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-border-radius
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox box corner radius (flat 0.3×rem, scaled by --wtv-checkbox-scale).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checked-bg
componentVariables.usage: Checked / indeterminate checkbox box background (defaults to the accent color).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checked-border-color
componentVariables.usage: Checked / indeterminate checkbox box border color.

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checked-bg-hover
componentVariables.usage: Checked / indeterminate checkbox background on hover (accent hover step).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-checkmark-color
componentVariables.usage: Check / dash glyph color (tints the mask).

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-width
componentVariables.usage: Focus-ring thickness for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-color
componentVariables.usage: Focus-ring color for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

componentVariables.name: wtv-checkbox-focus-ring
componentVariables.usage: Composed focus-ring box-shadow for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

componentVariables.name: wtv-dragged-scale
componentVariables.usage: Scale of the dimmed dragged node(s), left-anchored (0.95; set 1 to disable)

componentVariables.name: wtv-cut-opacity
componentVariables.usage: Opacity of cut nodes pending paste (0.4)

componentVariables.name: wtv-tooltip-width
componentVariables.usage: Node tooltip width (auto = shrink-to-content; set a length for a fixed box + max-width:none)

componentVariables.name: wtv-tooltip-min-width
componentVariables.usage: Node tooltip minimum width (0 = none; a floor that still grows up to max-width)

componentVariables.name: wtv-tooltip-max-width
componentVariables.usage: Node tooltip max width (wrap point; set none when using a fixed width)

componentVariables.name: wtv-context-menu-icon-width
componentVariables.usage: Icon column width in context menu

componentVariables.name: wtv-context-menu-icon-font-size
componentVariables.usage: Icon font size in context menu

componentVariables.name: wtv-tree-min-height
componentVariables.usage: Min height for empty and loading states (60px)

componentVariables.name: wtv-empty-zone-radius
componentVariables.usage: Empty tree drop zone border radius (8px)

componentVariables.name: wtv-empty-zone-hover-bg
componentVariables.usage: Empty drop zone background when engaged (hover / drag-over)

componentVariables.name: wtv-empty-zone-hover-border-color
componentVariables.usage: Empty drop zone border color when engaged

componentVariables.name: wtv-empty-zone-hover-shadow
componentVariables.usage: Empty drop zone glow when engaged (box-shadow)

componentVariables.name: wtv-empty-zone-hover-scale
componentVariables.usage: Empty drop zone scale when engaged (default 1; >1 can cause horizontal overflow)
